items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And then that was Earl Foster's brother. ... [INTERVIEWEE] He quit playing a long time.

ctx.x: But he died in the Tantry, I think, just some years back, he killed a man out there in McCormick, Mississippi.

And he was a trombone player in the band. Yeah, there was a trombone player in the band. And then that was Earl Foster's brother. I think he was with us right now. Earl Foster's brother. I don't know.
He quit playing a long time. And let's see, you had drums, bass, trombone trumpet? Mm-hm.

items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: George Lewis has told me about that.

ctx.x: And who was the piano player?
Called, we, his name was Lewis. We called him Big Eye Lewis.
It wasn't, I knew the clarinet player, Big Eye Lewis. No, not that. It was downtown.
